_comment: ccBar configuration, read from ~/.claude/ccbar.config.json. Every key is optional; a missing key uses its default. A list you set replaces the default list rather than adding to it. Unknown keys are ignored.

segments._comment: Switch each status line segment on (true) or off (false). retro and handoff hide only the line 1 markers; to stop the events themselves, use retro.enabled and handoff.enabled. subagents switches ccBar's subagent rows off; Claude Code then draws its own.

bar._comment: The context bar. filled_char and empty_char can be any character; use # and - on terminals without block characters.

thresholds._comment: Context percent. Green up to green, yellow up to yellow, red above. Rate limits use the same thresholds.

colors._comment: Valid values: reset bold black red green yellow blue magenta cyan white gray. bar_empty colors the unfilled bar cells; null uses the fill color. cost is used below cost.thresholds.yellow. cache_warm and cache_cold color the prompt cache group.

cost._comment: The cost is Claude Code's own estimate, not your billed charge. show: false hides it, same as segments.cost.

thresholds._comment: USD. Below yellow the cost uses colors.cost, from yellow colors.bar_yellow, from red colors.bar_red.

retro._comment: Session retro. Once per session, when context reaches threshold_tokens or threshold_pct of the model's window (whichever comes first), the Stop hook tells Claude to run the session-retro skill. enabled: false turns it off.

handoff._comment: Session handoff. Once per session, when context reaches threshold_tokens or threshold_pct (whichever comes first), the Stop hook tells Claude to run the session-handoff skill, which writes a plan to plans_dir and prints prompt_template with {path} set to the plan's path. enabled: false turns it off.
handoff.prompt_template: Read and execute this plan at: {path}

git._comment: dirty_marker: text shown after the branch when anything is uncommitted, untracked files included. timeout_ms: cap on each git call in milliseconds; a slower call is left off the bar. cache_ttl_ms: how long a git result is reused before git runs again.

icons._comment: branch: glyph before branch name (empty string = no icon). folder: glyph before folder name (empty string = no icon). dirty: glyph used instead of git.dirty_marker when set (null = use dirty_marker). worktree: glyph before the worktree name (empty string = "wt "). ascii_fallback: force plain-text icons.

rate_limits._comment: show_reset: show the time left until the 5h window resets. Claude Code sends rate limits only on Pro and Max plans, after the first response.

guards._comment: Optional guard hooks, active only after install.py --guards. enabled: false switches one guard off. line_endings: after Edit/Write, block when a tracked file's line endings no longer match git's checkout form. posted_text: before a gh/az command that posts text, block when it or a body file it references contains a banned entry; entries are literal substrings, and an empty list does nothing (example entry: "—", the em dash). build_gate: before git push or gh pr create, build the project roots touched by unpushed commits and block on a failed build; an empty builds list does nothing; each builds entry is a row or a preset name such as "dotnet"; see the README for the row format and examples.
